key_points: Barry Diller’s People Inc. scrapped its proposal to buy out MGM Resorts, causing after‑hours stock drop of ~9%.
MGM Resorts shares have fallen 5 straight days, down roughly 19% in recent sessions.
A deal investigation notification from BFA Law was issued, adding legal uncertainty.
Upcoming Q3 earnings call scheduled for Oct. 28, 2026, will provide further clarity.
Retail‑sector defensive rotation has highlighted MGM’s underperformance versus peers.
